title: npm ERR Peer Dep: How to Read and Fix ERESOLVE Properly
linkedin:
> Read the block first.

The `Found:` line is the version installed in your project; the `peer` line is the version some package demands. Then fix the real mismatch: upgrade or downgrade so the ranges overlap, or install a newer release of the complaining package that supports your version. Use `--legacy-peer-deps` only as a documented stopgap, and prefer `overrides` for a transitive pin.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/fix-npm-err-peer-dep/
